title: YouTube video or audio download result

results.title: Download link and file details
results.description: One dataset row per completed file: download_url, filename, content_type, size_bytes, charged_mb, expires_at, file_expires_at and run_id. For refreshed links, read Complete response and latest link instead.

response.title: Complete response and latest link
response.description: The OUTPUT record contains status and the latest hosted download link, file details, billed MB and expiry times. Links normally last up to five minutes; hosted files normally remain about 24 hours. Resurrect the same run with its original input to refresh a link without repeating a confirmed download charge.
